claims.text: Tamsulosin 0.4 mg QD, about ½ an hr after the same meal each day; don't crush, chew or open the capsules.
claims.quote: Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules 0.4 mg once daily is recommended as the dose for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of BPH. It should be administered approximately one-half hour following the same meal each day. Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules should not be crushed, chewed or opened.

claims.text: If there = ⍉response after 2 to 4 wks, the dose can go up to 0.8 mg QD.
claims.quote: For those patients who fail to respond to the 0.4 mg dose after 2 to 4 weeks of dosing, the dose of tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules can be increased to 0.8 mg once daily.

claims.text: After a break of several days, restart @ 0.4 mg QD.
claims.quote: If tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules administration is discontinued or interrupted for several days at either the 0.4 mg or 0.8 mg dose, therapy should be started again with the 0.4 mg once-daily dose.

claims.text: Tamsulosin CI: hypersensitivity (rxns have included rash, urticaria, pruritus, angioedema and resp Sx).
claims.quote: Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules are contraindicated in patients known to be hypersensitive to tamsulosin hydrochloride or any component of tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules. Reactions have included skin rash, urticaria, pruritus, angioedema, and respiratory symptoms

claims.text: Caution w a serious or life-threatening sulfa allergy.
claims.quote: If a patient reports a serious or life-threatening sulfa allergy, caution is warranted when administering tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules.

claims.text: Tamsulosin: ⍉w strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (eg, ketoconazole); caution w mod CYP3A4 inhibitors (eg, erythromycin), CYP2D6 inhibitors (eg, paroxetine, terbinafine) or in CYP2D6 poor metabolizers, esp above 0.4 mg.
claims.quote: Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules 0.4 mg should not be used with strong inhibitors of CYP3A4 (e.g., ketoconazole). Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules should be used with caution in combination with moderate inhibitors of CYP3A4 (e.g., erythromycin), in combination with strong (e.g., paroxetine) or moderate (e.g., terbinafine) inhibitors of CYP2D6, or in patients known to be CYP2D6 poor metabolizers, particularly at a dose higher than 0.4 mg (e.g., 0.8 mg).
Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules should not be used in combination with other alpha adrenergic blocking agents

claims.text: Caution w PDE5 inhibitors (both are vasodilators; together they can cause Sxtomatic hypotension)
claims.quote: Alpha-adrenergic blockers and PDE5 inhibitors are both vasodilators that can lower blood pressure. Concomitant use of these two drug classes can potentially cause symptomatic hypotension
Caution should be exercised with concomitant administration of warfarin and tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules

claims.text: B4 cataract or glaucoma surg, tell the ophthalmologist about tamsulosin:
claims.quote: Advise the patient when considering cataract or glaucoma surgery to tell their ophthalmologist that they have taken tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules

claims.text: intraoperative floppy iris syndrome has been seen in some pts on or previously treated w alpha-1 blockers.
claims.quote: Intraoperative Floppy Iris Syndrome (IFIS) has been observed during cataract and glaucoma surgery in some patients on or previously treated with alpha 1 blockers, including tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules

claims.text: Starting it when that surg = scheduled = ⍉recommended.
claims.quote: The initiation of therapy with tamsulosin in patients for whom cataract or glaucoma surgery is scheduled is not recommended.

claims.text: Postural hypotension Sx such as dizziness: caution w driving, operating machinery or hazardous tasks.
claims.quote: Advise the patient about the possible occurrence of symptoms related to postural hypotension, such as dizziness, when taking tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules, and they should be cautioned about driving, operating machinery, or performing hazardous tasks

claims.text: Tamsulosin OD: support the cardiovasc system first (supine position; if that isn't enough, consider IVF; then vasopressors if needed), and monitor and support renal funct.
claims.quote: support of the cardiovascular system is of first importance. Restoration of blood pressure and normalization of heart rate may be accomplished by keeping the patient in the supine position. If this measure is inadequate, then administration of intravenous fluids should be considered. If necessary, vasopressors should then be used and renal function should be monitored and supported as needed.

claims.text: Dialysis = unlikely to help (94% to 99% protein bound).
claims.quote: Laboratory data indicate that tamsulosin hydrochloride is 94% to 99% protein bound; therefore, dialysis is unlikely to be of benefit.
